audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gave Mel Level 1 and Level 6 outright, contradicting the packet chart (Skill, Skill, Ornn x5) and the already-audited mirror (mel__ornn), which records 'phases Skill / Skill / Ornn x5'.
audit.why: Ornn holds a 58.21% win rate over 1316 games; Level 1 is a skill lane (she pokes at 950 but he farms safely), and at 6 Call of the Forge God plus E-Q is a double displacement Mel cannot answer — Rebuttal is a 38s-at-rank-1 button she cannot raise while airborne.
audit.corrected: Row 0 becomes Skill (5/10) and row 4 becomes Ornn (6/10) in BOTH layers, matching the packet and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes listed generic spikes and never named Golden Eclipse or its 120s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse (R) is the spike that changes the level-6 math for Mel — it strikes Overwhelm-marked enemies at 25000 range, so distance is not a defence.
audit.corrected: Spikes now read: Mel — Solar Snare online, Golden Eclipse at 6 (120s), first item. Ornn — level 3 for Bellows Breath, Iceborn Gauntlet, 2-item front line.

audit.whatIsWrong: The text repeatedly called Golden Eclipse (R) a reflect ('her R reflect', 'she can't R-reflect in time', 'Hold her R to reflect your burst'). The reflect is Rebuttal (W). Golden Eclipse does no reflecting at all. Every one of Mel's ability names except Solar Snare was also absent (packet defect).
audit.why: Rebuttal (W) 'forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage, and grants her movement speed' — 38/35/33/29/26s. Golden Eclipse 'strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm regardless of their distance from her'. Naming the wrong ability tells the player to hold their combo for a 120s ult instead of a 38s barrier — the exact opposite of correct play. Solar Snare (E) is the 1000-range root at 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s and is the only thing in her kit that stops Searing Charge (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s). Searing Brilliance (P) grants three bonus projectiles on her NEXT attack after any ability, so the post-ability auto wind-up is the burst tell, not the cast.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal named as the damage-blank/movement-speed barrier with its 38s rank-1 cooldown; Golden Eclipse restated as the any-range Overwhelm strike; Solar Snare given its 1000 range and 11s cooldown as the anti-dash tool; Searing Brilliance's auto tell added.
sources: kit: Mel P/Q/W/E/R text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked only Solar Snare and used a placeholder description.
audit.why: Rebuttal at 38s rank 1 is by far the most punishable cooldown in the matchup — it is the one window where a full Ornn commit is free.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries Solar Snare's 1000/11s numbers and Rebuttal's 38s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2].d was a verbatim duplicate of tradeBad, and several strings used male pronouns for Mel.
audit.why: Duplicated text wastes a slot the player reads, and the pronouns read as copy-paste from a template.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[2].d now explains Brittle comes from Bellows Breath's final gout; pronouns corrected in the strings edited.

notes: The 'her R reflect' error appeared in five separate strings — Golden Eclipse (R) has no reflect; Rebuttal (W) does. All five are corrected here. DELIBERATELY NOT ASSERTED: whether Rebuttal actually reflects Ornn's Bellows Breath. The kit's derived flags mark Bellows Breath 'projectile', but Riot's own description reads 'Ornn advances, breathing fire' — a cone, not a projectile, so the flag looks like a tooltip-parse misfire and I did not tell the player his W gets reflected. Also not asserted: whether Solar Snare's root can be cleansed/QSS'd or whether Searing Charge can be Flash-buffered mid-charge — not in the kit text. Chart rows 0 and 4 are proposed as matched full+content pairs.
